visual.title: Two errors, two areas
visual.caption: Alpha is the area in the rejection region under the null. Beta is the area outside the rejection region under the alternative. Power is the remaining area of the alternative inside the rejection region.

predict.question: Which error is a Type II error?
options: Failing to reject a false null
predict.explain: A Type II error is failing to reject the null when the alternative is true. Its probability is beta, and power is one minus beta.
